title: Bridge battery disconnects
symptom: Bridge battery warnings randomly pop up on nightly versions, causing xDrip to stop reading glucose values and requiring app restart. The warning appears even after changing the battery in Blucon, and the battery is fine as validated by voltage measurement.
cause: Possible bug in persistent storage or Blucon stores battery low info even after battery change, taking a while to correct.
fix: Suggested to disable collector battery alert via settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert, and to use a Sony battery type.
evidence_quote: settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert?
